# Seattle Custom Furniture

> > Handcrafted, bespoke wood furniture and decorative pieces designed and built by Seattle artisans since 2012.

Seattle Custom Furniture specializes in custom-made furniture, architectural elements, and home decor featuring handmade wood designs, metal accents, and rustic-to-modern styles. The company serves the Pacific Northwest region including Seattle, Bellevue, Bainbridge Island, and Kirkland, working directly with clients on design consultations for unique, art-inspired pieces.
